_about: Hand-written learning topics with prerequisites. 'skills' lists the canonical skills a topic teaches; a gap in one of them selects the topic. A prerequisite is skipped when the user already has evidence for one of its skills.

topics.title: Python fundamentals
topics.goal: Write small Python programs with functions, lists, dictionaries and error handling.

topics.title: Web services with Python
topics.goal: Build a small REST service with one Python web framework.

topics.title: Data handling with pandas and NumPy
topics.goal: Load, clean and summarise a CSV dataset.

topics.title: SQL fundamentals
topics.goal: Write SELECT queries with WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY and aggregate functions.

topics.title: Object-oriented programming
topics.goal: Model a problem with classes, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism.

topics.title: Design patterns and SOLID
topics.goal: Recognise and apply common patterns such as Strategy, Factory and Observer.

topics.title: C# fundamentals
topics.goal: Write console programs in C# using types, collections and LINQ basics.

topics.title: .NET and ASP.NET Core
topics.goal: Build a small ASP.NET Core API backed by Entity Framework.

topics.title: Algorithms and data structures
topics.goal: Use arrays, hash maps, stacks, queues and trees, and reason about Big-O.

topics.title: Version control with Git
topics.goal: Use commits, branches, merges and pull requests in a shared repository.

topics.title: HTML and CSS
topics.goal: Build a responsive page layout with semantic HTML and CSS.

topics.title: JavaScript fundamentals
topics.goal: Manipulate the DOM and call an API with fetch.

topics.title: TypeScript
topics.goal: Add types to a JavaScript project.

topics.title: React
topics.goal: Build a component-based UI with state and props.

topics.title: Node.js backend
topics.goal: Build a REST API with Node.js.

topics.title: REST API design
topics.goal: Explain HTTP methods, status codes and resource-oriented endpoints.

topics.title: Unit testing
topics.goal: Write automated tests for functions and run them on every change.

topics.title: Linux and the command line
topics.goal: Navigate the file system, manage processes and write a short shell script.

topics.title: Containers with Docker
topics.goal: Containerise an application with a Dockerfile.

topics.title: Kubernetes
topics.goal: Deploy a container to a cluster with a Deployment and a Service.

topics.title: CI/CD pipelines
topics.goal: Run tests automatically on every push.

topics.title: Cloud fundamentals
topics.goal: Deploy a small service on one cloud provider.

topics.title: Machine learning fundamentals
topics.goal: Train and evaluate a classifier with a proper train/test split.

topics.title: Deep learning
